description: This file defines the 'CustomField' entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM. It includes constants for field types and screens, and defines properties with accessors for custom fields stored in the database.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Entity class for custom fields in the HR system, mapped to the 'hs_hr_custom_fields' database table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the custom field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the custom field.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the associated screen for the custom field.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the associated screen for the custom field.

methods.name: getExtraData
methods.description: Returns any extra data associated with the custom field.

methods.name: setExtraData
methods.description: Sets extra data for the custom field.
